title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the strategic resolution and intelligence runtime.
BNDY Backline is the capability/product name; bndy-enrichment remains the single strategic Backline runtime rather than creating a parallel repository.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.
BNDY Backline is the durable intelligence substrate: immutable evidence plus observations and atomised claims feed policy and projection; the graph is a derived view, not the authority.
Healthy source delivery requires both ingestion health and evidence-backed enrichment health; blank or explicitly unknown is safer than an invented classification or a wrong identity link.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. The workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Strategic Backline runtime for source acquisition, immutable evidence, observations, atomised claims, identity resolution, authority, projection, Capture processing and enrichment.

Live Cowork task definitions, source snapshots, cursors, state, machine run ledgers and human run reports. It is an operational evidence source for Backline, not a second strategic runtime or canonical authority.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

now.title: Lemonrock is Backline's first national flagship source
now.detail: The committed plan deliberately bootstraps the complete discoverable UK Lemonrock artist, venue and future-gig universe into source-native identities, immutable evidence and rich Claims before selective canonical projection.

now.title: BNDY Backline is a logical layer, not another app
now.detail: It lives inside the bndy-enrichment AWS runtime: Source Registry/Runner + S3 evidence + DynamoDB observations/claims + queues/workers + projection policy. The public BNDY database remains the canonical product projection, not the intelligence store.

now.title: Dual-path operating rule
now.detail: Building durable evidence/claims must not delay live gig publication. A trusted source can create claims and immediately project through canonical BNDY APIs while BNDY Backline keeps the evidence history for later reconciliation.

now.title: Source authority is source-specific
now.detail: KLMA is a controlled enduring community calendar and can support immediate additive projection. GigsNews is a human-curated weekly aggregation, so absence from a later page is not by itself cancellation evidence.

now.title: Two generations of claims thinking exist
now.detail: bndy-signals contains the older cognitive runtime; bndy-enrichment/BNDY Backline contains the strategic architecture.

now.title: Daily Backline discovery metrics
now.detail: DEPLOYED FOR GENERIC SOURCE RUNS. Each generic run produces one 180-day drill-down metric and atomically updates one 400-day source-family daily roll-up from the in-memory report, with DynamoDB TTL and no corpus/evidence scans. Godmode now exposes recent family runs and their item, event, profile, Claim, parked-row, warning, error and duration measures. Remaining: add resolved/unresolved/conflicted and queue/cost aggregates plus historical trend charts.

now.title: Safe entity enrichment worker
now.detail: GROUNDED PROVIDER CAPTURE EXECUTED; QUALIFICATION FAILED CLOSED. The approved one-shot ran against 10 live Trust Loop Artists and 10 Venues using Gemini 3.6 Flash with Google Search grounding. All 20 provider calls completed and the evidence artefact was committed. Three responses were captured cleanly and correctly abstained; 17 were rejected because their model-returned citation URLs did not exactly match structured grounding evidence. Zero facts were accepted, no provider was qualified or scheduled, review remains unstarted and canonical writes are zero. The artefact records $0.171399 measured cost, explicitly marked partial because the old error path discarded usage for rejected cases. PR 77 now quarantines only the offending fact while retaining raw response, citations, usage and cost. A second paid cohort has not been run.

now.title: Priority 1: Backline Trust Loop v1
now.detail: LIVE SHADOW, PROVIDER QUALIFICATION FAILED CLOSED. The deployed runtime still classifies the bounded 40-candidate Trust Loop cohort with no silent drops, no wrong links and zero canonical writes. Its 20-case grounded enrichment qualification has now run and is visible in the latest Trust Loop record: 3 clean captures, 17 capture errors, zero accepted facts and human review not started. Trust Loop v1 therefore remains unaccepted. The next controlled step is one repaired bounded recapture, then at least 20 human-reviewed known answers and the verified enrichment gate.

now.title: Hard gate: healthy artist enrichment
now.detail: FAILED CLOSED; REMEDIATION MERGED. The approved 20-case provider cohort did not prove healthy enrichment. It produced zero accepted facts because the strict citation boundary rejected 17 incomplete captures and the three clean responses abstained. No wrong-artist URL entered Backline and no canonical write occurred. The technical repair now preserves the complete reviewable response and usage while quarantining each ungrounded fact. The next gate is a separately authorised bounded recapture of the same cohort, followed by human adjudication of every identity and fact. Acceptance still requires zero false matches, at least 80 percent requested-predicate coverage where knowable, explicit attempted-no-official-presence outcomes, and sampled live review before any provider activation.

now.title: Embed and operationalise the evidence graph
now.detail: Integrate the existing bounded graph reader into Godmode and populate it with source identities, canonical candidates, resolution/conflict state and projection decisions. Operators must be able to search and expand from one node, see confidence and authority, and drill through to exact evidence and decision history without rendering or scanning the whole corpus.

now.title: Capture ongoing Cowork canonical activity
now.detail: CONTRACT LIVE, LEDGER INGESTION WAITING FOR FIRST RECORDS. Claude Cowork schedules remain explicit external canonical writers until replaced. bndy-ops now requires an append-only JSON ledger, human report, CTO inbox entry and canonical API read-back for every run, including no-change or failure. As at 14:34 UTC on 28 Aug the remote repository contains the v2 contract and schema but no run-ledger records, so Backline cannot yet hydrate current Cowork activity honestly. Once records arrive, ingest them as BNDY-origin Observations and Claims tagged with Cowork writer lineage and projection-suppressed to prevent a canonical feedback loop.

next.title: Controlled Backline projection
next.detail: After Trust Loop v1 passes, generate a complete shadow would-write report and review every proposed canonical action. KLMA is the first bounded additive-only candidate because its Stoke corpus is a useful known-answer cohort. The pilot must prohibit destructive changes, retain owner protection and stop thresholds, and requires separate human approval before any canonical write or Cowork writer transfer.

next.title: Bounded network discovery
next.detail: Only after identity quality is proven, add budgeted graph expansion from resolved Artists, Venues and Events. Enforce maximum depth, entities, fetches, model calls, time and cost; fully enrich selected nodes but expand edges selectively. Keep DynamoDB evidence and Claims authoritative and defer Neptune until measured graph workloads justify it.

next.title: Converge community and agent evidence
next.detail: Route Venue, Event, Festival, Capture, curator and MCP-assisted changes through durable Observations, Claims and projection policy after parity gates. Human and agent contributions should strengthen provenance and exception handling rather than bypass the Backline trust model.
